claims: The official NCAA March Madness Live app streams all 67 games of the 2026 Men’s Basketball Tournament across CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
The NCAA March Madness Live app requires a TV provider login for extended viewing.
The NCAA March Madness Live app offers live games, brackets, radio broadcasts, and multi-game viewing on iOS, Android, Fire TV, Roku, and desktop.
The NCAA March Madness Live app provides access to all 2026 Men’s Basketball Tournament games.
2026 Men’s Basketball Tournament games on TBS, TNT, and truTV can also be streamed on Max.
Paramount+ carries 2026 Men’s Basketball Tournament games broadcasting on CBS.
Users can stream up to four games simultaneously on tablets and desktop.
Users can stream up to two games simultaneously on phones.
The NCAA March Madness Live app includes the Capital One Bracket Challenge.
The NCAA March Madness Live app includes live game stats.
The NCAA March Madness Live app includes a "Perfect Bracket Tracker" widget.
The NCAA March Madness Live app features audio commentary for all games via Westwood One.
A cable, satellite, or live TV streaming service is required to watch games on the NCAA March Madness Live app.
The NCAA March Madness Live app is available on the Apple App Store.
The NCAA March Madness Live app is available on Google Play
